# Draft:Edward Murphy Kelehan

----
Born January 9th 1968, Amityville, Long Island, New York.
Son of Thomas and Kathleen Kelahan, he has three brothers Benjamin, Paul and Joseph Kelahan, one sister Clare Kelahan (Mutone). Three daughters, Cristina, Brianne and Kaley Kelahan.
Is an active member of The Screen Actors Guild and The American Federation of Television and Radio Artists and Writers Guild of America.
Studied Acting at "Maria Greco"s Dove Tails Actors Resources, Scene Study & Commercial Class Manhattan, New York, Ted Bardy Studio(Meisner Technique). CNC Studios Jagger Kaye- Commercial Class/Scene Study New York City Clayton Fletcher's Stand Up Comedy - Manhattan NY Drivers East Stunt Driving School - Vehicle Stunts & Precision Driving
"Host" along side of Rose Iebba of the TV show ADTV(Attention Deficit Television)
Co wrote & Co Created "Cuffs & Shield" With Mauricio Ovalle. Produced "The Last Minutes" "Cuffs & Shield" Despair" & The Cover Up". Wrote & Directed "The Cover Up".
Television Appearances:
Has Co-Star role in NBC's "The Blacklist" Episode Fredrick Barnes as DC Officer opposite Megan Boone & Diego Klattentoff.
Co-Star role in NBC's Unforgettable Episode Maps & Legends as Paramedic opposite Poppy Montgomery.
Co-Star role in Showtimes Billions Episode Currency as Phillip Carroll opposite David Costabile. Directed By Steph Green.
Co-Star role in NBC's "Bull" Episode Justice for Cable as Juror #7 opposite Michael Weatherly & Freddy Rodriguez.
Co-Star role on HBO's "The Deuce" Episode Were All Beasts as Patrolman #1 opposite Oscar Nominee Maggie Gyllenhaal.
Guest Anchor appearance on CNN's Anderson Coopers 360 30th Anniversary Space Shuttle Challenger Disaster portraying Lead Anchor Tom Mintier
Recurring role on NTD's "A Good Cop "as Desk Officer opposite Ignacyo Matynia & Cliff Lobrutto . Directed By David Chai.
Film/Movie appearances:
Supporting role & stunts as Undercover Detective in Revenge of the Green Dragons Directed by Andrew Loo.
Supporting & stunt driver role as NYPD in Tracers Directed by Daniel Benmayor.
Supporting role as Ron, the delivery driver in the movie Furlough Opposite Oscar winner, Melissa Leo and Blockbuster star Tessa Thompson. Directer by Laurie Collyer.
Supporting role as Officer Callahan in the movie to Live and Die in Bedstuy Opposite Jacinto Taras Riddick Directed by Joseph C Grant Jr.
Supporting role as Sol in Feature Film Honor Among Thieves opposite Azia Toussaint also directed by Joseph C Grant Jr.
Supporting role as Ice Agent#1 in Film "Sanctuary" Opposite Jon Michael Hill of TV series Elementary Directed by Devin Hampton.
Comedy Television Appearances:
Recurring role on Comedy Centrals "Mini Mocks" as "Police Officer" in Episodes "Sand Sculptor". "Finger Parkour" & Scared Sh-tless Fitness.
Co-Star roles in Comedy Central's Original's as the "Father" in episode "Yule Hide" Episode "Confetti Air Bag" as "Patrol Officer" and episode "The "Alec Baldwin Special". as arresting Police Officer.
